svg.title: Pacman client-server architecture over RabbitMQ and Protobuf
svg.desc: Server runs game logic and publishes state; client renders via Qt OpenGL and sends key inputs back, all over RabbitMQ with Protobuf serialization
svg.text: on every message in both directions
Files to create: pacman.proto · server_main.cpp · PacmanServer.h/cpp · ClientWidget.h/cpp (Qt) · CMakeLists (server + client)
